title: fix(layout,app-shell): a hidden icon-mode group label is no focus stop and is not announced (objectui#12795)
body:
Fixes #12795
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

In the collapsed (icon-mode) sidebar, the `SidebarGroupLabel` primitive hides a label with `opacity-0` and `-mt-8` only. The hidden label stays in the tab order when it is a button, and every hidden label stays in the accessibility tree.

Measured on `main` `0812a19`: Tab from the Page Authoring row lands on the Workspace group-label button at opacity 0. The focus ring is drawn on nothing, and Enter closes Workspace, a group the user cannot see.

Which labels could take focus (mechanism assumption 1, measured): only `NavigationRenderer`'s collapsible group label, an `asChild` disclosure button. The Recent label has a click handler but no tab stop. The Area, Starred, Favorites, `AppSchemaRenderer` Area and `SidebarNav` labels are plain divs. All of them were in the accessibility tree: 9 of 9 hidden showcase labels appear in the icon-mode aria snapshot on `main`.

## The change

Every `SidebarGroupLabel` call site now also passes `HIDDEN_ICON_LABEL_NOT_FOCUSABLE`. It is a module-local constant beside objectui#12744's `HIDDEN_ICON_LABEL_NO_POINTER`, under the primitive's own icon-mode variant `group-data-[state=collapsed]:group-data-[collapsible=icon]:`. It holds two classes:

- `invisible` (`visibility: hidden`): takes the label out of the tab order and the accessibility tree while the primitive hides it.
- `transition-[margin,opacity,visibility]`: under the same variant, `visibility` joins the primitive's transition list. The label stays visible while it fades out and is hidden when the fade ends. On expand the variant no longer applies, so the label is visible at once and fades in as before.

Call sites, 7 opening tags in 4 files:

- `@object-ui/layout` `NavigationRenderer`: the collapsible group label and the Favorites label;
- `@object-ui/layout` `AppSchemaRenderer`: the Area label (it also renders `Sidebar collapsible="icon"`, assumption 3);
- `@object-ui/layout` `SidebarNav`: the group labels (`collapsible="icon"` by default);
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `UnifiedSidebar`: the Area, Recent and Starred labels.

Off icon mode nothing changes: the variant does not apply in the expanded sidebar or the mobile sheet. `packages/components/src/ui/**` is untouched (AGENTS.md #7). No export, prop, type member or i18n key moves, and existing `data-testid`s stay.

### Why `invisible`, and the fade (assumption 4, measured)

A bare `invisible` would cut the fade-out: measured in the browser, the Recent label goes hidden on the first frame while its opacity is still running from 1 to 0. With `visibility` added to the transition list under the variant, the opacity curve is the same as on `main` (1.00 to 0.00 over about 200 ms), `visibility` stays `visible` throughout, and it turns `hidden` at about 205 to 220 ms. The fade-in on expand matches `main` frame for frame. An `inert` or `tabIndex` route would need the sidebar state in JavaScript at each call site; the class rides the primitive's own CSS condition.

### Deviation from the claim's surface

The claim allows `AppSchemaRenderer.tsx` and `SidebarNav.tsx` only where a label is focusable. Their labels are not focusable, but they were announced while invisible. The rulings require that no hidden label is in the accessibility tree and that an enumeration pin covers every call site, so both files carry the constant, with no exception list.

## Live readings

Setup: Chromium at 1280 x 800, light. Backend: objectstack `c1c0a90` `examples/app-showcase`, `objectstack dev --fresh`. Console: Vite from each worktree, `main` `0812a19` and this branch `d678720`. Every group was opened in the expanded sidebar, then the sidebar was collapsed with Ctrl+B.

Icon mode, focus on Page Authoring, then Tab:

| step | main | this branch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| start | Page Authoring row | Page Authoring row |
| Tab 1 | Workspace group-label button, opacity 0, visibility visible | My Work row, focus ring visible |
| Tab 2 | My Work row | Approvals row |
| Tab 3 | Approvals row | New Project (Wizard) row |
| Enter at Tab 1 | Workspace aria-expanded true to false, route unchanged | opens My Work, Workspace stays open |
| hidden labels in the aria snapshot | 9 of 9 | 0 of 9 |

Expanded sidebar (CONTROL), the same on both:

| step | main | this branch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| start | Page Authoring row | Page Authoring row |
| Tab 1 | More actions for Page Authoring (row menu) | More actions for Page Authoring (row menu) |
| Tab 2 | Workspace group label, opacity 1 | Workspace group label, opacity 1 |
| Tab 3 | My Work row | My Work row |
| Enter at Tab 2 | Workspace aria-expanded true to false, route unchanged | Workspace aria-expanded true to false, route unchanged |
| labels in the aria snapshot | 9 of 9 | 9 of 9 |

Screenshots, from the evidence branch `claude/issue-12795-evidence`, which is never merged here:

- Icon rail, keyboard focus on the row after Page Authoring (My Work), this branch, light: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/301f5d44bc29a2a626a066fc9409f03d12810d39/docs/design/findings/12795/icon-rail-focus-after-page-authoring-light.png?raw=true
- Expanded sidebar, keyboard focus on the Workspace group label, this branch, light (CONTROL): https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/301f5d44bc29a2a626a066fc9409f03d12810d39/docs/design/findings/12795/expanded-group-label-focus-light.png?raw=true
- Before, `main`, icon rail after the same Tab, where focus sits on the invisible Workspace label: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/301f5d44bc29a2a626a066fc9409f03d12810d39/docs/design/findings/12795/main-icon-rail-focus-on-hidden-label-light.png?raw=true

## Tests (at `d678720`)

- `packages/layout/src/__tests__/sidebarGroupLabel.iconModeFocus-12795.test.tsx` (8 tests) and `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar.iconModeLabelFocus-12795.test.tsx` (4 tests). Both render through the real `SidebarProvider` / `Sidebar` / `SidebarGroupLabel` and the real renderers. The labels' own class tokens are compiled with the real `tailwindcss` compiler and injected, so the DOM computes `visibility` from the classes the labels carry. The pins then read behaviour: user-event's Tab order and Testing Library's accessibility tree.
  - Collapsed: Tab goes from the row above a group to the group's first row, and from a group's last row to the next group's first row. No label takes focus. Every label computes `visibility: hidden`, keeps `opacity: 0` and is inaccessible. The expected tokens are derived from the primitive's own `opacity-0` token, so a primitive that changes its hiding condition turns the pins red.
  - CONTROL, expanded: the group label is a focus stop after the row above it, Enter toggles its group closed and open, the Recent label still opens Recent on click, and every label is shown and announced.
  - These two files run under jsdom, because happy-dom does not match the `:is(:where(.group)...)` selectors Tailwind emits for group variants. They stub `matchMedia`, which jsdom lacks.
- `packages/layout/src/__tests__/sidebarGroupLabel.callSites-12795.test.ts` (enumeration pin). It reads every opening tag of `SidebarGroupLabel` in `packages/` and `apps/` source (the synced `ui/` copy and tests aside) and asserts each passes the constant, declared in its own file with exactly the derived pair. It has a control that the known call sites are found, and it fails if a file renames the primitive on import.
- Ablations, through `ablation-replace.mjs`. Each mutation was confirmed on disk, and each restore was proven: the blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

| mutation | red | green |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NavigationRenderer: the `invisible` token removed (the `main` shape) | enumeration row; both collapsed tests (the walk reads PAGE_AUTHORING, Sales, ...) | expanded CONTROL |
| NavigationRenderer: `invisible` made unconditional | enumeration row; collapsed and both expanded CONTROL tests | the other call sites |
| UnifiedSidebar: the `invisible` token removed | enumeration row; both collapsed app-shell tests | expanded CONTROL |
| AppSchemaRenderer: the call site drops the constant | enumeration row; its collapsed test | the rest |
| SidebarNav: the call site drops the constant | enumeration row; its collapsed test | the rest |
| NavigationRenderer: the visibility-transition token removed | enumeration row; both collapsed tests | expanded CONTROL |

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/layout test`: exit 0, Test Files 43 passed (43), Tests 370 passed (370).
- `@object-ui/app-shell` in full, as `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/ --shard=K/8` for K = 1 to 8, run in sequence because an unsharded run exceeds the container's command limit. Every shard exited 0: 1528 files passed and 1 skipped, 14434 tests passed and 9 skipped, 0 failed.
- `type-check` for both packages: exit 0, and `--listFiles` shows each new test in its package's test program. The closure build and `build` for both packages: exit 0. eslint on the 7 touched files: 0 errors, and every warning sits on an unchanged line. `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check-changeset-presence` (2 changesets for 2 released packages), `check:new-line-citations` and `check-control-bytes`: all exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- In the console, a collapsible group's label button never fades, on `main` or here. `apps/console/src/index.css` sets an unlayered `button:not([disabled])` transition (`transform, filter`) under `@media (hover: hover)`, which outranks the primitive's layered transition. Div labels fade as designed. Not filed.
- A closed group shows no rows in icon mode and its label is now invisible, so its entries have no keyboard path until the sidebar expands. On `main`, Tab and Enter on the invisible label opened it by accident, which is the defect removed here. objectui#12744's PR notes the same for the pointer.
- `visibility: hidden` also stops hit-testing, so objectui#12744's pointer-events class now matters only during the roughly 200 ms fade-out. It is left in place.

The work was done in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_016gcD8krj7QLd3njFMYsi1g`.
